Patch 1.2.5

Hey everyone here are the notes for the week. Pretty small all in all, as I said we're working on 1.3!

  • Accessory Resealing has been added. It follows the same pattern as the weapon and armor resealing.
  • Saltwater Fish Schools will now accept all types of Chopped Fish as chum
  • The movement speed has been increased to 10,0 m/s for the following mounts:
  • Royal Griffin
  • Vanity Bouncy Cow
  • Vanity Hellfire Steed
  • Vanity Hero Statues have been added. While they cannot be sold for gold, they can be used as decor. Heroes who did not get statues before the change will be receiving these as a small thanks for their efforts.
  • The Immunity Zone at the top of Veroe is now turned into a proper Peace Zone, disabling some of the possible griefing
  • Due to very popular demand, the Pawesome Festival has been extended by a week!
  • A crafting recipe has been added in Mirage Isle, under Vanity Mounts category, to exchange your existing Ser Meatball for an updated version of the mount with working skills.
  • The visual effect for Crystal Nova (Crystal Wings glider skill) has been fixed

== Patch 1.2.5 ==
Hey everyone here are the notes for the week. Pretty small all in all, as I said we're working on 1.3!

* Accessory Resealing has been added. It follows the same pattern as the weapon and armor resealing.
* Saltwater Fish Schools will now accept all types of Chopped Fish as chum
* The movement speed has been increased to 10,0 m/s for the following mounts:
* Royal Griffin
* Vanity Bouncy Cow
* Vanity Hellfire Steed
* Vanity Hero Statues have been added. While they cannot be sold for gold, they can be used as decor. Heroes who did not get statues before the change will be receiving these as a small thanks for their efforts.
* The Immunity Zone at the top of Veroe is now turned into a proper Peace Zone, disabling some of the possible griefing
* Due to very popular demand, the Pawesome Festival has been extended by a week!
* A crafting recipe has been added in Mirage Isle, under Vanity Mounts category, to exchange your existing Ser Meatball for an updated version of the mount with working skills.
* The visual effect for Crystal Nova (Crystal Wings glider skill) has been fixed
